 (BY SHRI ANAND BHATT, GOVT. ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER
Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the applicant/accused,
relating to FIR/Crime No.48/2016 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Economic Offences Wing, District Ujjain (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable u/S 406, 409, 420 and 120- B of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Economic Offences Wing, District Ujjain
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2 . Prosecution story in brief is that during the period 2009- 2016, accused persons Gurpeet Singh,
Hardeep Singh, Sunil Dutt, Sukhjeet Kaur, Solly Thomas, Ranjodh Singh, being director of GN Gold Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the "company") (converted name- GN Dairies Ltd.) present applicant Baljeet Singh being Zonal Manger of the Company branch at Ujjain and accused Rajendra Singh,
Baljeet Sharma @ Baljeet Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181222130/
1 being branch manager of the company and others had assured several complainants to get their money doubled in 5 years.

sentences.text:
The applicant and co-accused persons got a sum of Rs.32,07,892/-
deposited by t h e complainants.
Maturity amount was Rs.57,59,223/-.
The policies were issued in the name of the complainants but after completion of maturity period, the applicant and accused persons had not given the matured amount to the complainants.
Thereby, the present applicant and accused persons after conspiring fraudulently, got the amount.
But till date no amount of money has been paid by the applicant and accused persons.
An FIR was lodged against the applicants and co-accused persons.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has not committed the offence and has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is submitted that applicant was posted as Zonal Manager of the company at Ujjain is not vicarious liable along with co-accused persons.
No specific role of the applicant has been leveled against him.
The company has not been made as an accused in the case.
Applicant left the company in the year 2012.
It is also submitted applicant is in custody since 06.10.2020.
Till date, only 23 prosecution witnesses have been examined before the trial Court and 40 prosecution witnesses are to be examined.
Trial will take considerable long time for its disposal therefore, prayer is made to enlarge the applicant on bail.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has objected the prayer by submitting that 17 criminal cases of like wise offence were registered against the applicant, out of which in six criminal cases applicant is acquitted and other cases are pending till date.
Applicant has criminal antecedents.
It is further submitted that bail application of co-accused Satnam Singh Randhawa is dismissed by this Court vide order dated 24.01.2024 passed in M.Cr.C. No.46812/2023 therefore,
applicant
is also not entitled for grant of bail.

5. Status report dated 11.01.2024 received from trial court and as per the report almost 20 prosecution witnesses are yet to be examined before the trial court.
6. Having considered the rival submissions and looking to the fact that after dismissal of his earlier bail application, there is no change in the circumstances, therefore, at this stage, this Court is of the view that it is not a fit case for grant of bail to the applicant.
Resultantly, this bail application is dismissed.

(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE ajit Baljeet Sharma @ Baljeet Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181222130/
